text:
marco: Quick sanity check before we open publisher onboarding ticket: do we have a finalized mapping for SKU -> meter_name across AWS/GCP/Azure? Need tokens vs embeddings split for billing.

sarah-partnerships: Not finalized. I sketched a mapping in the doc but left region tagging as optional. My thinking: meter codes should be cloud-agnostic (e.g., RW_TOKENS, RW_EMBeddings, RW_SESSIONS) and we add cloud, region as metadata fields on the purchase event.

elaine-legal: Reminder: any SKU exposed to marketplace UI that references "free" or "trial" needs the trial duration in the offer metadata and a clause in the EULA. If you plan trials, add the exact hours/days and opt-out wording.

devon-eng: For E2E tests we need a sandbox publisher and at least one exchangeable offer per cloud. Ops, can you provision sandbox creds? We'll automate the smoke that purchases an offer and asserts the event includes sku,meter,offer_id.

ops-bot: sandbox provision request received. ETA 1 business day. Ticket: SAND-1793.

marco: OK — owners: Sarah -> meter naming doc, Devon -> smoke tests and event schema, Elaine -> EULA snippet and DPA pointer, Ops -> sandbox creds. I'll schedule a 20m sync tomorrow to sign off.

sarah-partnerships: I updated the doc with RW_TOKENS / RW_EMB / RW_SESS keys. Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/marketplace/meter-mapping. Please review before the sync.

elaine-legal: I'll add the minimal trial text inline and flag anything Azure-specific.

marco: Thanks all, small win to unblock legal review and staging canary. :thumbsup:
